title: A finite product of etale algebras is etale (Stacks 00U2 (11))
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $n\ge0$, and $B_1,\dots,B_n$ commutative $A$-algebras such that each $\operatorname{Spec}B_j\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Then for the product $A$-algebra $B=B_1\times\cdots\times B_n$ (for $n=0$ the zero ring) the morphism $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00U2 (lemma-etale, line 39290), item (11), direction 'if', applied n-1 times
